title: Maintenance
d: Maintain Marathon gear: clean, dry, inspect, store.
definition: Maintain Marathon gear: clean, dry, inspect, store.
description: Maintenance for Marathon equipment: clean after use, dry fully before storage, inspect before every session, store out of sun and damp. Shoes are rotated; kit prevents chafing. title: Fitting guide

title: Safety standards

title: Youth gear

title: Budget guide

definition: Equip for Marathon at any budget: spend on safety first.
description: Budgeting Marathon gear: spend first on protection and fit, then on the implement, last on accessories. Shoes are rotated; kit prevents chafing. Good used gear beats bad new gear for non-safety items. Plan the yearly replacement cycle so costs never surprise you mid-season.

title: Rules on equipment
